## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change.
- [ ] Machine-specific values come from `SKY_*` settings; new settings are in `telescope.env.example` with a comment.
- [ ] No personal paths, host names, addresses, keys or e-mail addresses in code, docs, screenshots or commit messages.
- [ ] New or changed upstream requests are cached, rate-polite, validated (no open proxy) and attributed; NOTICE.md lists the provider and its terms.

- [ ] Anything not tested is said above.
